anchor_cases.exam_name: CBSE Class XII Board Examination 2025 — Bargarh Centres, Odisha
anchor_cases.cycle_or_stage: Mass Copying Enquiry & Cancellation of 516 Class XII Student Results
anchor_cases.schedule_summary: Chief Nodal Supervisors reported mass copying at two Bargarh (Odisha) centres — Padampur Public School and Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Bandupali — leading CBSE to hold 1,185 results on 13 May 2025.
anchor_cases.schedule_document_ref: Lok Sabha Unstarred Question No. 2410 (04.08.2025): CBSE Bargarh (Odisha) Class XII 'Result Later' Action
anchor_cases.outcome_summary: CBSE accepted its Unfair Means Committee report cancelling subject results of 516 Class XII students (exonerating 61 Class XII students) and releasing final results on 26 May 2025.
anchor_cases.outcome_document_ref: Lok Sabha Unstarred Question No. 2410 (04.08.2025): Cancellation of 516 Class XII Results at Bargarh Centres
anchor_cases.affected_candidates_basis: Exact count of 516 Class XII students whose subject results were cancelled at Bargarh centres per LS USQ 2410.

anchor_cases.exam_name: CBSE Class X Board Examination 2025 — Bargarh Centres, Odisha
anchor_cases.cycle_or_stage: Mass Copying Enquiry & Cancellation of 369 Class X Student Results
anchor_cases.schedule_summary: After CBSE Class X exams at Padampur Public School and Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya (Bandupali) in Bargarh, Odisha, 1,185 Class X/XII candidates were placed under 'Result Later' on 13 May 2025 following mass-copying reports.
anchor_cases.schedule_document_ref: Lok Sabha Unstarred Question No. 2410 (04.08.2025): CBSE Bargarh (Odisha) Centres 'Result Later' Hold (13.05.2025)
anchor_cases.outcome_summary: Following Unfair Means Committee enquiry, subject results of 369 Class X candidates were cancelled (239 Class X exonerated), final results declared on 26 May 2025 (13-day delay), and school staff placed under disciplinary action.
anchor_cases.outcome_document_ref: Lok Sabha Unstarred Question No. 2410 (04.08.2025): Cancellation of 369 Class X Results and 26.05.2025 Final Declaration
anchor_cases.affected_candidates_basis: Exact count of 369 Class X students whose subject results were cancelled at Bargarh centres per LS USQ 2410.
